That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Search locket, Lucky Coin, Photo album, Trail compass, Bus Schedule. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing. Not yours. It knew your name — it said it wrong, like it learned the shape of the sound but not what it meant.
